description: Authoritative list of files allowed to import node:child_process directly, outside test files. Consumed by packages/core/ci.js (checkArchitecturePolicy, the `ndx ci` architecture-policy step) and tests/e2e/architecture-policy.test.js — both load this file, so the two enforcement points cannot drift apart; a parity test in architecture-policy.test.js fails if their verdicts differ. Paths are relative to the project root. Everything else must use @n-dx/llm-client exec(), spawnTool() or spawnManaged(). Remove an entry when its file stops importing child_process (packages/core/claude-integration.js was removed that way after it moved to win-spawn.js) rather than leaving it permitted-but-unused.

excludeDirs..claude/worktrees: Gitignored agent-session worktrees. Each is a full checkout, so scanning one re-reports every allowlisted file under a .claude/worktrees/<name>/ prefix the list does not recognize.
excludeDirs..local_testing: Gitignored scratch space for local harness runs; throwaway fixture projects left there are not committed source.
